title: 2026-11-09 论文推荐
description: 9 篇推荐：NUMA-Torch: Compiler-Driven NUMA-Aware LLM Prefill on Multi-Socket CPUs (University of Moratuwa, NUMA 拓扑不该由运行时去猜，编译器按 socket 切权重就能把 prefill 拉回本地带宽上限。)、AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression (NVIDIA, 剪枝的目标函数该是 serving engine 的实测代价，而不是参数量。)、SPARE: Fast Linear Attention Decoding with Compact Recurrent States (University of Virginia, 递归状态是低秩的，存小一点、少搬几次，解码就快了。)、Beyond K/V Caches: Cross-Model State Handoff in Hybrid Linear-Attention LLMs (South China University of Technology, 模型切换要搬的不只是 K/V，还有递归状态与卷积历史，而且三者要按顺序对齐。)

highlights.name: Recursive Sparse Attention
highlights.note: 树状 KV 摘要把选择成本降到 O(log L)，1M 上下文 RULER 60.5 分

highlights.name: AutoCompress
highlights.note: 把 serving 代价模型接进剪枝搜索，Nemotron 120B→74B 保 95% 分

highlights.name: NUMA-Torch
highlights.note: 编译器按 NUMA socket 切权重，多路 CPU prefill 最高 2.63 倍
